description: Local Ollama LLM models for offline AI inference

fields.label: Enable Thinking
fields.helpText: Let thinking-capable models (Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, and kin) reason before answering. Reasoning streams into the thinking display rather than the reply. When off (the default), the model is asked to answer directly — best when you need clean output such as JSON. Either way, any <think> blocks that leak into the reply are routed to the thinking display.

fields.label: Thinking Effort

enumValues.label: Model default
enumValues.description: Let the model decide how long to think

fields.helpText: How long the model may reason before answering. On a local machine every reasoning token is wall-clock time, so this is the largest speed control you have. Needs a recent Ollama and a model whose template understands effort levels; older servers fall back to plain thinking.

fields.label: Keep Model Loaded

enumValues.label: Server default
enumValues.description: Whatever your Ollama is configured to do

enumValues.label: Unload immediately
enumValues.description: Free the memory as soon as the reply is done

enumValues.label: Keep loaded
enumValues.description: Never unload while the server runs

fields.helpText: How long Ollama keeps this model in memory after a reply. The server unloads after five minutes by default, and reloading a large model costs half a minute on the next message. Set per profile, so a big chat model can stay resident while a small utility one unloads at once. Leave on "Server default" and your OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE setting is left entirely alone.

fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.helpText: How long to wait for the server before giving up (default 300). While streaming this covers only the wait for the first token, so a long answer is never cut off mid-sentence — but loading a large model and reading a long prompt both happen before that first token. Raise it if big models on a busy machine abort with "operation was aborted"; lower it if you would rather a stalled server fail quickly. Leave blank for the default.

groups.title: Sampling
groups.helpText: Sent only when filled in; blank leaves the model’s own default in charge. Model publishers usually name the values they want — Qwen3 asks for Top K 20 and Min P 0.

fields.label: Top K
fields.helpText: Keep only the K most likely next tokens.

fields.label: Min P
fields.helpText: Drop tokens less likely than this fraction of the best one.

fields.label: Repeat Penalty
fields.helpText: Penalty applied to tokens already used. Above 1 discourages repetition; 1 disables it.

fields.label: Presence Penalty
fields.helpText: Discourages tokens that have appeared at all. Some publishers recommend a value for non-thinking mode (Qwen3.8 asks for 1.5).

fields.label: Frequency Penalty
fields.helpText: Discourages tokens in proportion to how often they have already appeared.

fields.label: Seed
fields.helpText: Fixes the sampler so the same prompt gives the same answer.

attachment.description: File attachments not yet supported (requires multimodal model detection)
attachment.notes: Multimodal models like llava can process images, but require model-specific implementation
